blocks.html: Stakeholder Mapping is the process of identifying key decision-makers, influencers, and end users within a target account, and analyzing their roles, interests, and level of influence to develop a structured engagement strategy.

In complex B2B sales, multiple stakeholders are involved in purchasing decisions. Stakeholder mapping helps sales teams understand who is involved, what each stakeholder cares about, and how they influence the buying process. This enables more targeted and effective engagement strategies.

items.html: Identifying all relevant stakeholders in an account

blocks.html: Increases win rates in complex sales
This information is often visualized in stakeholder maps or org charts.
A sales team maps out a procurement manager, CTO, and finance head within a target company and tailors messaging for each stakeholder’s priorities.
Stakeholder Mapping helps sales teams navigate complex buying groups by identifying key influencers and tailoring engagement strategies accordingly.
Win complex deals with precision. MarketJoy helps businesses map stakeholders effectively to improve engagement, alignment, and deal success.
